description: veil 0.10 API library (crates.io veil-proxy, full-container: epoll readiness reactor, no tokio or hyper). #[veil::route] handlers with path/query extraction, serde_json responses, compression through [api] compression, WebSocket through WebSocketUpgrade, gRPC services generated by veil-build (prost), /static/* through App::serve_dir. One process with four listeners from the configuration file; HTTP/3 via quiche.
